{"id":"KITH-1ln3.9","title":"kith-tui: typing 'q' in the message input quits the app","description":"Found in chinwag/kith-tui live smoke test 2026-10-30 (kith 556bf4c, chinwag 830be27). Demo blocker for Tue 2026-11-03.

Evidence: focus starts on the input box (app.rs:93 Focus::Input). `tmux send-keys -l 'a quick test'` -> kith-tui exited immediately with status 0 (KITH_EXIT=0) after "a ", without sending anything.

Cause: event.rs handle_key, the `KeyCode::Char('q') if modifiers.is_empty() => state.quit = true` arm (line 23) comes before `KeyCode::Char(c) if state.focus == Focus::Input` (line 48), so a lowercase q quits whatever has focus. Any message containing "q" (quick, question, quote...) kills the client.

Fix direction: only treat 'q' as quit when focus == ChatList (Ctrl-C stays global). Regression test: Input focus + Char('q') inserts 'q' and leaves quit false.
